Carlos Grande — personal knowledge site

Canonical site URL: https://carlosgrande.me/
Primary language: English. Spanish translations are also available for selected pages under https://carlosgrande.me/es/.

This site is Carlos Grande's personal life cheat sheet: a collection of projects, articles, notebooks, and practical resources about coding, data architecture, data science, visualization, business, and AI. Carlos Grande describes himself as a Data Engineer, Architect, and coding enthusiast.
